原: News report two Staff at a suburban

理由: 标题和正文第一句连在一起漏了句号

原: with a broken arm, Firefighters struggled
改为: with a broken arm, firefighters struggled

原: attending to the clean up were
理由: 名词 cleanup 误拆成两个词（上一句也写作 cleanup）

原: No, no the table is fine.
改为: No, no, the table is fine.

原: The Life Changing Magic of Tidying Up
改为: The Life-Changing Magic of Tidying Up
理由: 书名复合形容词漏连字符

原: the wisdom of the Con Marie method
改为: the wisdom of the KonMari method

原: a difference in his community. One lunch at a time.

原: is a great tool, however it’s important

理由: however 连接两个分句，前面应用分号、后面加逗号
